judgment.notes: All 52 accepted paragraphs S001–S052 are copied faithfully and assigned to the plan; N001–N011 and P have identifiable expanded outputs. The covariance, two frequency majorants, dyadic summation, exponent-zero remainder, continuous estimates, interpolation, actual residual, restarted low/high stability, bootstrap and fixed-timestep density route are all present. The split helpers T013–T017 have producers rather than extra root premises. Nevertheless the typed route does not preserve the source's smooth-path argument: SmoothOn requires analytic time coefficients, and Piecewise, FlowOutput, SourceApprox and SmoothApprox inherit it. R001 S003 establishes time smoothness by higher Sobolev regularity, not time analyticity; T001 supplies no corresponding analytic conversion obligation. T005/T014 also restrict the accepted arbitrary smooth-path domains. Moreover the proposed Weak relation does not express the weak equation used in R006/R009. These are semantic route failures despite complete paragraph coverage, not demands for completed worker proof bodies.

scope: Coverage is reviewer-reported; reading alone is not mathematical assessment.
